name: agents-pane
description: A pane in the Claude chat that lists every agent of the session as it runs: subagents, each workflow's agents grouped under their workflow, and teammates, with each one's model, effort, status, context size and running time.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane when an agent starts
autoOpen.description: Opens the Agents pane by itself when the first agent of the session starts. Once you close the pane it stays closed until you run /agents-pane again.

tickMs.title: Running-time refresh (ms)
tickMs.description: How often the running time of running agents is redrawn, in milliseconds. At least 250.

maxAgents.title: Agents kept
maxAgents.description: How many agents the pane remembers; the oldest finished ones go first. At least 10.

labelChars.title: Agent name length (characters)
labelChars.description: How much of an agent's name (the task description it was given) is shown. At least 10.

rowGap.title: Space between agents (lines)
rowGap.description: Blank lines between two independent agents or workflows, each with everything under it. 0 packs them tight.

childRowGap.title: Space between sub-agents (lines)
childRowGap.description: Blank lines between an agent or workflow and the agents under it, and between those agents. Keep it below the space between agents so each family reads as one block.

indentCells.title: Indent of a sub-agent (characters)
indentCells.description: How far an agent started by another agent, or by a workflow, is moved right of its parent. At least 1.
